disputes.description: The packet's two functions have different ABIs and the schema allows only one signature. The value above records 0x004A4900 as unsigned __int8 __thiscall(_DWORD *this, int a2); 0x004CF070 is instead _DWORD *__thiscall(int this) returning the allocated collision-array pointer. A second, separate ABI record is required to represent 0x004CF070.

Both functions use __thiscall and touch the same 'this' offset pattern (0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC/0x10/0x14), but same convention and same offsets do not prove shared ownership. 0x004A4900 belongs to an unknown per-vehicle pit-crew animation object; 0x004CF070 belongs to an unknown SpecialFX subsystem object. Neither owner is evidenced as the same type.
